report.summary: Cellox tissue rehearsal. Top plans by likelihood-weighted incremental profit: #1 g0-newbuyer EV 4,325 THB; #2 g0-flash EV -9,485 THB; #3 g0-targeted EV -35,163 THB. The original plan is weakest in S1 (median -1,990,658 THB). Suggested alternative: Welcome voucher for new buyers only (lean media) (17.0571% voucher). Adaptive loop: 12 rival reactions and 4 of our rule firings across plans (middle seed). Message appeal source: appeal_fallback. The original exceeded its approved loss risk in S1. Legacy playback uses a conservative Low confidence label.

similar_campaigns.description: Cellox Giant 6-roll pack listed at 99-113 THB on HomePro next to Scott Extra Super Jumbo 6-roll at 97-115 THB, so the two brands are priced head to head with similar promo ranges (about 12-16%). Snapshot; dates not shown.
Cellox Premium Botanis 6-roll pack listed at 84 THB, down from 92 THB (8% off), on HomePro's online store. Snapshot of an everyday price promotion; date of the promotion not shown.
Scott Extra Double Roll 24-pack listed at 242-289 THB on HomePro, implying about 16% off at the low price. Snapshot; dates not shown.
Scott Extra Super Jumbo Roll 24-pack listed at 321-382 THB on HomePro, implying a promotional price up to about 16% below the regular price. Snapshot; promotion dates not shown.
Zilk Kotton 24-roll pack listed at 130-145 THB on HomePro, implying a promotional price about 10% below regular. Zilk is the value brand competing on price. Snapshot; dates not shown.

Cellox Purify (BJC) ran a purchase-triggered lucky draw: buy Cellox Purify tissue worth 199 THB, SMS the receipt number, and enter a draw for trips to Korea and a year of free product. A non-price promotion aimed at existing household buyers.

Cellox Giant 6-roll pack listed at 99-113 THB on HomePro next to Scott Extra Super Jumbo 6-roll at 97-115 THB, so the two brands are priced head to head with similar promo ranges (about 12-16%). Snapshot; dates not shown.

Scott Clean Care 3-ply toilet tissue sold on LazMall as a 32+8 roll bundle (8 free rolls, equal to 20% off per roll). A bundle mechanic typical of mega-sale stock-up offers. Snapshot; dates not shown.

assumptions: AI-vs-AI rehearsal for the Cellox reference pack on Shopee, priced from market.json.
The strategist proposes alternatives within the approved discount and budget bounds.
Rivals react per scenario: S1 passive, S2 most likely, S3 aggressive, S4 red team.
Shopper agents come from household personas; message appeal uses SSR or the fallback.
Plans are compared with a paired no-campaign baseline on the same seeds.
Proceed requires median S1 incremental profit of at least zero and loss risk at most 25%.
Includes a two-week post-campaign window to capture pull-forward.

changes.reason: Win shoppers who do not buy us yet with almost no paid media; loyal buyers keep paying full price, so the discount does not leak to sales we would make anyway.
